sentences.text:
Heard Sri Chandra Dutt, learned counsel for the petitioners, Sri Akhileshwar Singh, learned Acsc
for the State-respondents and Sri Abhinav Krishna Srivastava, learned counsel for Kanpur
Development Authority.

2.  This writ petition is preferred for the following principal reliefs:
"i). issue a writ, order or direction, in the nature of mandamus, directing the respondent No. 3 to initiate inquiry against respondent No. 4 in respect of demolition of construction made in Arazi No. 2111 Mi. Rakva 0.1000 Hectare and Arazi No. 2112 Rakva 0.0400 Hectare without acquisition or demarcation of land in question i.e.
Arazi No.2111 Mi. Rakva 0.1000 Hectare and Arazi No.2112 Rakva 0.0400 Hectare situated at Mauja Budpur Mchhariya, Tehsil and District Kanpur Nagar.

ii). issue a writ, order or direction, in the nature of mandamus, commanding the respondent No. 4 not to demolish further construction in the shape of house without giving opportunity of hearing to the petitioners in respect of land in question i.e.
Arazi No. 2111 Mi. Rakva 0.1000 Hectare and Arazi No. 2112 Rakva 0.0400 Hectare situated at Mauja Budpur Mchhariya, Tehsil and District Kanpur Nagar.
iii).

issue a writ, order or direction, in the nature of mandamus, commanding the respondent No. 4 to provide compensation of 5 Lakhs rupees for illegal demolition conducted by the Kanpur Development Authority without giving any notice or opportunity of hearing to the petitioners and without having any authority of Law. "

3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submitted that the petitioners had only raised the boundary wall just to protect his agricultural field and the respondents in an arbitrary manner had carried out the demolition.

4. Per contra, learned counsel for KDA submitted that the land has been purchased for agriculture purpose but in fact the petitioners demarcated the said land into plots for the purpose of development & sale.
Admittedly, the land itself falls in the territorial of Kanpur Development Authority, which is constituted under the U.P. Urban Planning and Development Act, 1973.

entities.text: U.P. Urban Planning and Development Act, 1973
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The object of the Authority is to ensure that no development may be carried out contrary to the plan approved.

In the instant matter, at no point of time, any such division or fragmentation of holding Ram Narayan And Another vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 6 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41987122/
2 has been placed before the authority and consequently no relief can be accorded.
5.

entities.text: Ram Narayan And Another vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the factual situation wherein nothing has been brought on record to indicate or suggest that there was any such plan, which has been approved qua carrying out the fragmentation of holding by the competent authority, no such relief can be accorded to the petitioners.

However, in case, the petitioners are inclined to raise any such construction, definitely, they may move an appropriate application before the concerned authority and the same shall be decided in accordance with law.
6. With the aforesaid observation, writ petition is disposed of.
